CoffeeCalc.metadataDescription: Convert any price into cups of coffee. Multi-currency coffee calculator.
CoffeeCalc.title: How Many <accent>Coffees</accent> Is That?
CoffeeCalc.subtitle: Convert any price into cups of coffee. Because everything makes more sense measured in caffeine.
funFacts: Finland consumes the most coffee per capita — about 12 kg per person per year!
Coffee is the second most traded commodity on Earth, right after crude oil.
The average American spends about $1,100 per year on coffee.
A Starbucks Grande Latte in Zurich costs around $7.50 — one of the priciest in the world.
Brazil produces about a third of the world's coffee supply.
CoffeeCalc.seoText: We spend on coffee every day, making it the perfect unit to understand the real cost of things. Whether you're budgeting, comparing prices, or just curious — CoffeeCalc helps you see any price through the lens of your favorite drink. Multi-currency support lets you compare coffee costs worldwide.
CoffeeCalc.disclaimer: Prices are approximate averages. Actual coffee prices vary by location.
